prompt: Review whether FANUC has a material causal relationship to humanoid robotics and embodied AI through controls, servos, robots, simulation integration, installed base, and service economics; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Physical-AI adoption can transmit into FANUC control, servo, robot, integration and service demand through its installed automation base, provided repeat paid deployments and attributable profitable revenue become material.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if physical-AI activity remains demonstrations, fixed automation captures the economics without incremental FANUC content, or FANUC cannot disclose material repeat paid demand and profitable revenue attribution.
